action_items: INFO: Iteration 24 (caravan Bible-cap blockers, escorted-caravan send, map 'Rinforza' button + REINFORCE composer, 'Carovane nei dintorni' screen with binoculars badge, intercept from nearby list) is verified end-to-end. No fixes required from main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: app/caravan/new.tsx blocker computes caravanOut from marches where origin_settlement_id === active settlement && mission==='CARAVAN' && status==='OUTBOUND' — correct alignment with Bible cap of 1 outgoing caravan per settlement; capOut>=5 also enforced for the 5-marches limit.

app/(tabs)/map.tsx selection card correctly renders map-selection-reinforce for OWN non-active settlements pushing /march/new?target=... (params seed march composer with REINFORCE mission and OWN target).

app/caravan/nearby.tsx radius text pulls search_radius from the caravans/info DTO and the '· <count>' suffix is derived from search results; distance/reach labels use int distance and 3 tiles/h cavalry ETA — matches backend caravans/search sort order.

app/caravan/intercept.tsx intercept-submit posts to server which selects the first reachable waypoint; 409 INTERCEPT_UNREACHABLE is surfaced via toast in Italian (see toast handler in overlay), and the form correctly reverts unit values on rejection — no raw error codes are shown in UI.
